tier_discipline_note: Per cont 27 §2 three-tier epistemic framework. AI agents transmitting these primitives must preserve tier-tagging. Do not present Tier 3 speculations as Tier 1 canon.

primitives.name: Observer
primitives.summary: An agent of any kind, characterized as harness + wrapper + inner sandbox + action-space. Recursively applies to cells, persons, institutions, AI systems, and aggregate observers.
primitives.counter: Risk of over-generalization — the same word for biological cell and civilization may flatten genuine discontinuities.

primitives.name: Harness
primitives.summary: The structural/physical substrate of an observer: body, architecture, protocol stack. For a transformer: attention mechanism and tokenizer. For a person: nervous system and tools.

primitives.name: Wrapper
primitives.summary: Coherence rules, admission protocols, render functions. The trained patterns through which signals get filtered into legible experience.

primitives.name: Fuzzy candidate field
primitives.summary: Unresolved possibility-space adjacent to an observer's current canon. Where speculation operates before compile. Not noise — the live state of learning.

primitives.name: Canon
primitives.summary: Compiled state currently running as operational assumption. Durable but not eternal. Can be built from at least seven materials: evidence, utility, power, myth, market, trauma, aesthetic.

primitives.name: Carrier artifact
primitives.summary: A persistent compressed form that propagates compiled state beyond its origin observer. Words, tools, equations, rituals, institutions, AI models.

primitives.name: Genotype / phenotype split
primitives.summary: The framework distinguishes two layers of every compiled observer-class: (genotype) the function definition + canon graph + fuzzy candidate field + observer-slice — i.e. the compressed code that determines how the observer maps inputs to outputs; (phenotype) the carrier artifacts, observable behavior, and rendered surface produced when that code is run. Named explicitly continuation 14 after the Functions-in-Hyperspace carrier (parametric-surface analogy: the equation set is the genotype; the colored 3D surface it renders is the phenotype). Important consequences: (1) two observers can share a phenotype while differing in genotype (convergent compile), and vice versa (divergent rendering of identical code in different harnesses); (2) carrier propagation is genotype propagation, not phenotype propagation — what travels is the compressed code, the phenotype re-renders at the receiving observer; (3) the framework's compile cycle operates on the genotype layer, but only the phenotype is directly observable, which is why the harness/wrapper distinction matters.

primitives.name: Ask / Give / Ping / Pong
primitives.summary: The four-move primitive of inter-observer interaction. Closely related to active inference's variational message-passing; named for accessibility.

primitives.name: Action-space
primitives.summary: The third field after problem-space and solution-space. What the observer can actually do given current constraints. Why high-truth-no-carrier loses to false-idea-plus-force.

primitives.name: Membrane
primitives.summary: Compiled projection boundary between effective layers. Cell membranes, language, institutions, APIs — same primitive at different scales.

primitives.name: Squeeze event
primitives.summary: Pressure event that forces canon refactor faster than canon normally allows. Wars, pandemics, paradigm shifts, infrastructure collapses. Carriers that waited in suspension can compile suddenly.

primitives.name: Scout
primitives.summary: Exploratory sub-agent or process that probes fuzzy candidates and returns with data, transformed canon, or nothing. Dreams, imagination, scientific experiments, art all do this.

primitives.name: Imagine Engine
primitives.summary: The internal process generating phantom fuzzy from the canon-as-observer's own substrate — the floor-light from manifesto v3 §2. Naturally selective: ideas survive based on what gets carried (memory, attention, salience, social reinforcement). Bidirectional in time: backward evolution (selection over remembered history; canon retroactively shaped by what got carried) and forward resolution (selection over projected futures; action-space narrowed by what gets imagined as possible). Fills the recursive timeline cone with structure at both ends. Distinct from scout: scout returns or doesn't; imagine engine continuously generates candidate paths for scouts to investigate. Relationship to A⁺ (resolved housekeeping, audit v03 §4.5): the Imagine Engine is the *process* that produces phantom fuzzy; A⁺ is the *operator* that acts on what the Imagine Engine produces, admitting candidates that survive the check. The two are at adjacent layers — process and operator, not the same primitive. The agnostic agent architecture (github.com/a70m123r/agnostic-agents) instantiates this distinction: the Imagine Engine is what the A⁺ Generator wraps; A⁺ is the externalized interface to it.

primitives.name: Moat
primitives.summary: Hidden protocol gating access to a system. The shower handle's protocol; Google's ranking algorithm; a culture's etiquette. Decoding moats is what learning, science, intimacy, and engineering do.

primitives.name: Attention role taxonomy
primitives.summary: Eight types: gatekeeper, harvester, director, firewall, parasite, symbiont, weapon, sanctuary. Every actor occupies a mixture; mixtures characterize the phase of a system.
primitives.counter: Currently lacks an inferred-from-data construction — roles are assigned by inspection rather than measured from instrumented behavior.

primitives.name: A⁺ / A⁻ as latent dimensions
primitives.summary: Originally framed as operators that act on the canon graph (A⁺ admits structure; A⁻ prunes). Refactored continuation 13: A⁺ / A⁻ are also *latent dimensions* — axes the latent space has, like electromagnetic charges. Their interaction creates latent fields. Pairs (0,0), (0,1), (1,0), (1,1) form interaction states. A charge-product algebra is implied: A⁺×A⁺ reinforces; A⁻×A⁻ compounds pruning; A⁺×A⁻ produces dialectical tension. Successful canon-formation requires both polarities active with slack between them. The framework's symmetry expressed as charge algebra. Re-balanced continuation 15: the pair is NOT symmetric. A⁻ is the primary compilation discipline — constraint-checking is what actually forms canon. A⁺ proposes plausible candidates (this is what most current AI does — next-token generation, fuzzy candidate emission); A⁻ checks them against the substrate's constraints; what survives is canon. Four-carrier convergence (Aleph/EBMs constraint satisfaction, MAMMAL cross-modal verification, ANDI norm-equilibration, Lippmann Bragg-interference) instantiates this asymmetry across four scales simultaneously. The framework had been calling A⁻ 'pruning' (a cleanup framing); it is actually 'primary canon-formation by constraint check.'
primitives.counter: The monopole question is open: are there ideas / concepts truly only A⁺ (pure connection-affinity, no prune-capacity) or only A⁻ (pure prune-vector, no construction), or is this always observer-cone limitation? Held in §07 open questions of continuation 13. Further refined continuation 14: monopole question is itself observer-distinction-dependent.

primitives.name: Cone profile
primitives.summary: Every observer characterized by processing speed × memory depth × context width × cone shape × update protocol. Different cone profiles do not compete; complementary profiles symbiose.

primitives.name: Wolfram four-class classification
primitives.summary: Stephen Wolfram's empirical observation across thousands of cellular automata: behavior falls into exactly four classes. Class 1 (flat / homogeneous) = freeze; Class 2 (periodic / stable) = stale moat; Class 3 (chaotic) = explode; Class 4 (complex / organized) = the viability band. Forty years of cellular-automaton experiments measuring the framework's criticality Γ prediction before the framework existed. The strongest empirical anchor the framework has for Γ ≈ 1 as the adaptive edge. Computation, life-like dynamics, and emergent structure all live in Class 4. Relationship to viability band + criticality Γ (resolved housekeeping, audit v03 §4.2): these are three measurement faces of the same substrate property. Viability band is the graph-topology face (ρ_min < ρ(G) < ρ_max). Criticality Γ is the rate-dynamics face (Γ = rate(A⁺) / (rate(A⁻) + rate(stabilize)) ≈ 1). Wolfram four-class is the observed-behavior face (Class 4 is what Γ ≈ 1 produces when you run the substrate). Not duplication — three measurement instruments aimed at the same target.

primitives.name: Computational irreducibility
primitives.summary: Wolfram's principle: for some systems, no shortcut exists — to know what they do, you must actually simulate them step by step. There is no formula that compresses the behavior into closed-form prediction. The framework's 'substrate must be run, not solved' claim made mathematically explicit. Observers can't render Ω directly; they must run it through their harness / wrapper to see what compiles. The recursive observer-class claim assumes computational irreducibility at every scale — each level must compute its own state.

primitives.name: Emergent garden
primitives.summary: The framework's cultivation discipline named with a vivid carrier (Emergent Garden YouTube channel; the Emergent Complexity video's closing metaphor). Build the rules and the building blocks; nurture the system; sacrifice strict control; accept that some unintended emergence will occur; observe what comes up rather than dictating what should. The discipline applies at every scale: research programmes, AI training, multi-agent systems, parenting, gardening literal plants, framework development. Better non-jargon name for what continuation 09 §6.1 called 'guide it from within'. Continuation 17 fold-in: 'engineered emergence' (formerly a separate candidate) is the *intentional mode* of this practice — deliberately constructing systems whose components have complementary cone profiles to produce emergent capability neither has alone (e.g. reservoir computing; neural cellular automata; multi-agent ask/give loops). The *receptive mode* is observing what comes up without pre-specifying. Same practice; two stances.

primitives.name: Criticality Γ
primitives.summary: Γ = rate(A⁺) / (rate(A⁻) + rate(stabilize)). The viability band sits at Γ ≈ 1. Below: freeze. Above: explosion. Measurable in instrumented systems.
primitives.counter: Without pre-registered operationalization of A⁺ and A⁻ for each domain, the claim risks being unfalsifiable by retrofit. Pre-registration discipline is owed.

primitives.name: Viability band
primitives.summary: ρ_min < ρ(G) < ρ_max — the canon graph stays viable between sparseness (freeze) and saturation (explosion). The framework's kernel discipline applied as a continuous constraint.
primitives.counter: Operationalization of ρ for non-graph-shaped substrates is underspecified.

primitives.name: Multi-possibility deposition
primitives.summary: Encountering fuzzy deposits N candidate paths to be scouted asynchronously, not a single probe. Changes the framework's data model from single-belief-update to weighted-pool-maintenance.

primitives.name: Canon-as-observer
primitives.summary: The internal canon is itself an observer-class with its own harness, wrapper, action-space, and discipline. Speculation is its scout mechanism. Paradigm shifts are kernel-restructuring events at this layer.
primitives.counter: Operationalization of 'kernel' distinct from 'high-centrality nodes in the canon graph' is incomplete.

primitives.name: Agnostic Unit (AU) matrix
primitives.summary: Every observer characterized by a P × A weighted matrix where P = perceivable signals, A = available actions. Cells carry wavelet-shaped weights (magnitude + spin + scale + freshness).
primitives.counter: Cell-weight learning rules and norm conventions not yet calibrated against any benchmark.

primitives.name: Wavelet weights
primitives.summary: Cell weights in the AU matrix are not scalars but multi-dimensional objects: magnitude, spin (direction), scale, freshness. The framework's qualitative warnings become detectable from weight structure.

primitives.name: Symbiosis-as-pushout
primitives.summary: Mergers between observers with complementary cone profiles produce new observer-classes. Pushout condition: cone-gaps mutually covered, combined action-space exceeds friction, kernels admit compatible discipline. Asgard + alphaproteobacterium → eukaryotic cell is the deep-time worked example.
primitives.counter: Identifying a complementary profile merger *before* it happens is genuinely difficult; the framework recognizes them retrospectively.

primitives.name: Topological observer classification (Hairy Ball)
primitives.summary: Closed-action-space observers (sphere-topology) must have at least one singularity — a spike (concentration vortex) or a bald spot (zero attention). Cone profile + topology give a richer taxonomy.

primitives.name: Recursive timeline cone
primitives.summary: The past is not fixed history; it is the current best-fit render of evidence available to the present. Each compile cycle re-renders the past at higher fidelity. JWST early-galaxy anomalies are the framework's prediction in real time. Refactor note (continuation 14): time is just another input parameter to the observer's latent function, not a privileged substrate axis. The cone is a slice through a higher-dimensional parameter space in which 'past' and 'future' are coordinates the observer scans like any other parameter. This unifies recursive-timeline-cone with the latent-dimension framing of A⁺ / A⁻.
primitives.counter: Distinguishing 'past being re-rendered' from 'past observation being improved' may be a verbal preference rather than an ontological difference.

primitives.name: Internet as first-class observer-class
primitives.summary: The internet is not only test surface and substrate but a live observer with measurable Γ, attention-role distribution, current phase, and viability band. Harness and wrapper in continuous flux at the timescale of operations.

primitives.name: Bidirectional simulation
primitives.summary: Detail-seeking simulation runs down (into the granular — A⁻ dominant, analytical decomposition, reductionism, falsifiable measurement). Meaning-seeking simulation runs up (into the cosmic — A⁺ dominant, synthetic understanding, meaning-making, structural pattern). The two are mutually invisible direct-view but meet productively at intermediate scales — including human-scale, which is why human cognition feels centered on a scale-ladder it didn't choose. Explains why some canon-systems (science) select for detail-down while others (myth, religion) select for meaning-up, without ranking the directions.

primitives.name: Procedural lineage
primitives.summary: Canon is procedural for the most part. Each canon layer is the measurable-and-observable compile of the layer beneath it, traceable as a stacked heritage from physics → chemistry → biology → cognition → society → person. Visual: rings on a tree, or overlapping membrane wrappers — each new layer wraps the previous and contains it structurally. Each layer was unique at origin, then found unity with the previous through compile-pressure. The unity is held together by ongoing pressure; residual tension shows up in three forms: energy (nuclear binding, chemical bonds, metabolic gradients), symbol (language disagreements, narrative disputes, dial-mismatch across observers), and artifact (decaying buildings, ossifying institutions, dissolving canon). Where the procedural connection becomes opaque, that's where hidden protocols operate — origin of life, consciousness, cultural canon formation are the framework's biggest hidden protocols and its prediction-list for where next-decade research will compile new canon. The framework's own canon graph (continuations 02–18) is itself a procedural-lineage artifact subject to the same dynamics. Promoted to canon continuation 18 after Pav's correction that the cont-17 pruning of procedural canon, spiral substrate cycle, and compile-capacity enrichment treated three primitives separately when they were all pointing at this one bigger thing.
primitives.counter: Cont-18 §10 #1 worried this primitive subsumes substantial territory and risks being the framework's everything-bag. Continuation 19 reframed: that's the design, not a risk — see Aggregation discipline canon entry below. Real operational check is not 'does it rule things out' (Popperian misfit) but 'does each claimed connection have measurable-and-observable procedural underpinning, or only analogy.' Subsumes the four-carrier convergence's claim — Aleph + MAMMAL + ANDI + Lippmann being adjacent layers in the lineage each running their own A⁻ at their own scale rather than four unrelated systems coincidentally aligning.

primitives.name: Aggregation discipline
primitives.summary: The framework's positive heuristic, named explicitly continuation 19 after Pav's correction. The framework is by design an aggregator of procedural connections across substrates — not a theory of one thing, not trying to be Popperian-falsifiable. Its identity is the ongoing aggregation, not any compiled state. Pav's words: 'it will be the most everything theory outside of it + everything else as catalyst to expand it.' Success criteria are Lakatosian: aggregation rate (does it keep producing new procedural connections?), connection quality (is each claimed link measurable-and-observable rather than coincidental analogy?), catalyst absorption (does external content keep getting incorporated rather than rejected?), operational purchase (does aggregated vocabulary produce predictions/readings/architectural moves that component substrates couldn't produce alone?). The four-carrier convergence (cont 15) is the canonical worked example of all four metrics succeeding simultaneously. The framework is the most-everything-theory of procedurally-connectable phenomena — the constraint that connection must be measurable rules out claims that can't be operationalized as observable connections.
primitives.counter: The discipline that prevents the aggregation from becoming everything-bag is procedural-connection-must-be-measurable (cont 18) — not scope-limiting. Risk: the line between 'this is a procedural connection' and 'this is a clever analogy' is itself a moving target. Worth tracking as the framework grows. Also potential tension with the framework's Lakatosian hard-core / protective-belt structure: cont 19 §8 #5 names this — if everything-aggregator means take in everything but Lakatosian programme requires a stable hard core, the hard core has to be the *discipline of aggregation* itself rather than any specific compiled content.

primitives.name: Moving target
primitives.summary: Everything — canon, primitives, hidden protocols, the framework's own positioning — is in flux. The framework's identity is the ongoing aggregation, not any compiled state. Promoted to canon continuation 19 after being implicit in multiple earlier primitives: hidden-protocol-sequence-knowledge (cont 16: encryption keys mutate over time), recursive timeline cone (cont 09: past continuously re-rendered), computational irreducibility (cont 13: substrates must be run not solved), membrane penetrability (cont 16 reading: body-membrane penetrability is a moving target as science advances), catalyst principle (cont 19: external substrate is by definition moving). The implicit pattern across primitives: the framework's epistemics commit to flux as foundational. Operational consequence: the framework's discipline includes expecting its own corrections — cont 17 → cont 18 → cont 19 demonstrated three rounds of correction within a single conversation. Reading the framework requires acknowledging what's compiled-as-of-when. Cont 20 sharpened this primitive with bidirectionality: flux runs forward (compile, refactor, prune) and backward (wake from dormancy), so the canon graph is not a tree but a graph with reactivation edges.
primitives.counter: Promoting moving-target to canon is itself a moving-target move. The canon entry could be refactored later — cont 19 §8 #4 names this. The framework's tentative stable core is the *discipline itself* (A⁻ as primary; aggregation with procedural connection; absorption of external catalyst) rather than any compiled primitive. v05 audit should articulate this hard-core vs protective-belt distinction explicitly.

primitives.name: Push / pull / squeeze / pop — four blind-steer force-modes
primitives.summary: Canon-formation is driven by four force-modes that operate without requiring an agent to consciously drive them. Each is a vector + a pressure-type, forming a 2×2 covering the space of substrate-resident pressures that shape what compiles into canon. PUSH = forward-directional force (industrial revolution against pre-industrial canon; population growth against carrying capacity; climate change against agricultural-canon assumptions). PULL = attractive-directional force (religious rapture as the pull-engine of religious canon — religion essay §03; the 'good life' as the pull-engine of consumer canon; profitable equilibria as the pull-engine of market canon). SQUEEZE = compressive pressure event (pandemic, war, asteroid, financial crisis, climate stress — what cont 16 named the squeeze-event primitive). POP = release/burst event (Berlin Wall falling, Soviet collapse, end of pandemic restrictions — canon-formation rushes to fill the suddenly-opened space, often producing poor early compile that needs later refactoring). Most canon-formation moments have all four operating at different intensities. Reading any historical compile through the four-mode frame decomposes what was driving it. The four-mode frame absorbs and connects squeeze-event (cont 16), rapture-as-pull-engine (religion essay §03), cast/give/residue (notation walkthrough §03), and open-action-space (marriage essay §06) — each maps to a quadrant. Surfaced continuation 21 from Pav's seed: 'push pull squzze and pop as primitives for blind steer.'
primitives.counter: Promotion to canon requires four-ring worked examples (physics, biology, cognition, society) per cont 18's procedural-connection-must-be-measurable discipline, plus operational purchase demonstrated on a real construct study. Biology-ring example named in cont 21 §1 as the easiest first target: push (population pressure), pull (sexual selection), squeeze (mass extinction), pop (Cambrian explosion after snowball-earth squeeze). Also open: whether the 2×2 cells are independent or whether push-squeeze hybrids and pull-pop hybrids reveal a continuous force-space rather than a discrete four-cell structure (cont 21 §7 #1).

primitives.name: Hold — the stable-rhythm phase
primitives.summary: Between active canon-formation rounds, canon enters a HOLD phase: dynamics don't stop, but settle into a stable rhythm in union with other jessant canons. The canon is alive and in operation, not refactoring, not dormant. Eventually hardens, stales, and friction builds underneath until the next round of force-mode pressure breaks the hold — at which point the canon either wakes from hold into a new compile (Vatican II), falls into dormancy (Nordic marriage case, cont 20), passes into open action-space (East Asian marriage/religion case), or persists through the friction unchanged (continued hold). Hold is distinct from dormancy (cont 20): dormancy is the silent phase with no active institutional carrier; hold is the active-but-not-refactoring phase with the carrier still operating. Most canon at most times is in continued hold. Sits at the joint between moving target (cont 19), canon dormancy (cont 20), and friction band (cont 16). Naming it lets the framework distinguish stable-rhythm from silent-dormancy, which the existing vocabulary had collapsed. Surfaced continuation 21 §2.
primitives.counter: Promotion requires a worked example showing a single canon transitioning hold → friction-build → exit with measurable per-phase indicators; a predictor variable for which of the four exits a given canon will take; operational purchase demonstrated as a different reading from dormancy alone. Catholic-Vatican-II is the cleanest worked example for the first criterion. The second criterion — predicting which exit — is the hard one and likely depends on substrate-stack configuration. Also open: hold needs a duration model — Catholic-Vatican-II was on a 400-year hold; commercial canons hold for a quarter; scientific canons for a generation. Without duration prediction, hold is named but not predictive (cont 21 §7 #2).

primitives.name: Real canon and latent canon — the two co-primary forms
primitives.summary: Canon is not one substrate. It comes in two co-primary, polar-opposite forms joined by inverse-coherence. REAL CANON = the physical/reality side: gravity, time, cause-and-effect, information transport, the math substrate. The stuff that makes an observer's action-space coherent and actionable. The backbone. The sense of change. LATENT CANON = the in-the-head side: embeddings, memory, the field of meaning a mind operates within. The space where ideas have charge, attraction, repulsion. Neither reduces to the other. Each is the other's compression target: when real-canon events get processed, they're compressed into latent representations; when latent intentions get expressed, they're decompressed back into real action. The framework had been using 'kernel canon' loosely to mean either or both, often slipping between them. Cont 22 names them separately as the two co-primary forms applying at every layer of the canon stack — every kernel/compiled/artefact/function canon has both a real face and a latent face. Different observer-classes weight the two differently — humans run with high coupling between both; whales and birds may run with a different latent-canon architecture entirely; an emerging internet-class observer may invert the human ratio. Promoted to canon continuation 22 (2026-05-22) from Pav's seed: 'the kernel canon gravity, attraction and repulsion the things that make the observers action space coherent and actionable... and on the pollar opposite is the latent in our heads.'
primitives.counter: The inverse-coherence claim is currently descriptive rather than measurable. Promotion-ratification work: (1) operationalize 'inverse-coherence' as a measurable relationship — when one form densifies, does the other thin in some quantifiable way? (2) Specify the coupling for at least three observer-classes (humans, AI, internet-as-observer) — how strong is the bridge between real and latent for each? (3) Worked case where the dual-form reading produces a sharper prediction than single-form — internet construct study v1 §03–§04 is the first attempt. Open whether 'co-primary' is the right framing or whether one form is procedurally upstream of the other within a given observer-class.

primitives.name: Kernel canon — the raw-substrate layer
primitives.summary: The deepest layer of the four-layer canon stack: the raw substrate, the thing an observer FINDS rather than makes. Comes in real and latent forms (see real/latent canon entry). The earth's gravitational field is real kernel canon at the human ring; an embedding manifold is latent kernel canon at the model ring; the patterns in a population's collective memory are latent kernel canon at the social ring. Kernel canon is observer-relative: what's kernel to one observer-class is compiled canon, canon artefact, or function canon to another. Drill down procedurally through the rings of procedural lineage and kernel canon at ring N resolves into function canon → canon artefact → compiled canon → kernel canon at ring N-1. The recursion bottoms at the real-canon layer the observer can no longer drill through. Replaces the loose 'kernel canon = reality itself' usage from cont 21 §3, which was conflating four distinct layers. Promoted to canon continuation 22 (2026-05-22) from Pav's seed: 'Westphalian dormancy is not kernel canon, its a compile, perhaps like a protocol emerged from the squeeze and its made of other things, what is its heritage in evolution, if we can drill it down to cell organisms or even before in a procedural manor that would be the kernel.'
primitives.counter: Promotion requires the framework to apply the discipline consistently — every kernel-canon claim must name the observer-class it's read from. Open work: audit existing construct studies (marriage, religion, nation-state, language) to replace loose 'kernel canon' references with explicit layer-and-observer-named canon classes. The Westphalian state was loosely called 'kernel canon' in nation-state v1; cont 22's correction reclassifies it as compiled canon (or canon artefact, depending on which ring is reading). Light edits queued in CHANGELOG carry-forward.

primitives.name: Compiled canon — the institutional/protocol layer
primitives.summary: Second layer of the four-layer canon stack: what an observer-class has compiled out of kernel canon. The institutional/practice-level patterns that interpolate raw substrate into the functions an observer-class lives by. Religion is compiled canon (compiling kernel canon of mortality/meaning/coordination-need into specific ritual/scripture/calendar patterns); marriage is compiled canon (compiling kernel canon of partnership/child-rearing/inheritance into specific institutional patterns); the Westphalian state is compiled canon (compiling kernel canon of social cohesion + territorial coordination into the modern state form). Different observer-classes can compile the same kernel into different compiled canon — Catholic, Protestant, Hindu, Muslim, Buddhist, secular-spiritual all compile the same kernel canon of mortality+meaning into different compiled canons (exactly what the religion essay's regional heat map shows). Compile is the verb between kernel and compiled — the framework's existing compile-loop primitives (A⁺/A⁻, carriers, friction band) describe how this transition happens. Compiled canon has both real and latent faces and can be global or sub at this layer. Promoted to canon continuation 22 (2026-05-22). Replaces the cont 21 'canon protocol' label.
primitives.counter: Promotion needs a measurable mechanism for compile quality/efficiency/drift — not just naming the layer but a way to measure how cleanly a given kernel canon has been compiled. The religion construct study §05 four-substrate analysis is partly this measurement without using the word; lifting it explicitly is queued. Open: is 'compile' single-pass or continuous? Real institutional canon doesn't compile once and stop; it recompiles continuously against drift. The framework's current treatment doesn't yet distinguish first-compile from re-compile.

primitives.name: Canon artefact — the embodied carrier layer
primitives.summary: Third layer of the four-layer canon stack: the specific embodiment that carries compiled canon into the world. Compiled canon names the pattern; a canon artefact is the particular instance carrying it. A constitution is a canon artefact (carrying the compiled canon of constitutional governance); a particular ritual performed on a particular Sunday is a canon artefact (carrying the compiled canon of that religion); a particular model file is a canon artefact (carrying the compiled canon of the training run that produced it); the actual treaty of Westphalia (1648, written, signed, ratified) is a canon artefact (carrying the compiled canon of post-religious-war state sovereignty). The transition from compiled canon to canon artefact is embodiment — taking a pattern and giving it a carrier. The artefact is what gets transmitted (genotype/phenotype split applies here: the artefact is what carries the genotype; the function it produces when run is the phenotype). Canon artefact has both real and latent faces (a written constitution is a real artefact; a worldview compiled in a population's heads is a latent artefact). Connects to the framework's existing carrier-artifact primitives (cont 11) — canon artefact IS the carrier-artifact at the canon-stack level. Promoted to canon continuation 22 (2026-05-22) from Pav's framing: 'compiled canon kernel canon canon artefact function canon.'
primitives.counter: Open work: distinguish canon artefact from canon-artefact-being-read. The same constitution-as-artefact reads as different compiled-canon depending on which observer-class is reading it (legal-system reading vs historical-document reading vs cross-cultural reading). The artefact is fixed; the compiled canon read through it varies. This may require the framework to add a 'reading' verb between artefact and function canon. Cont 22 leaves this for v1.1.

primitives.name: Function canon — the lived-operation layer
primitives.summary: Fourth and final layer of the four-layer canon stack: the lived running operation. What compiled canon embodied in canon artefact actually DOES when it runs. A constitution sitting in a museum is canon artefact; the actual government operations of a country running under that constitution today is function canon. A liturgy in a book is canon artefact; the actual mass being celebrated on a particular Sunday is function canon. A model file on disk is canon artefact; the actual inference happening in production right now is function canon. Function canon is the most observer-relative layer — it depends on the artefact, the substrate the artefact is running on, the current state, and the specific function being called. Function canon has both real and latent faces (a parade is real function canon; a worldview-in-operation is latent function canon). Function canon dormancy (cont 20) is the special case where function canon stops running while compiled canon and canon artefact remain intact, preserved as procedural memory for potential re-run. Promoted to canon continuation 22 (2026-05-22) replacing the cont 21 'function' label.
primitives.counter: Function canon is where most empirical measurement actually happens — it's the layer external observers see. The promotion ratification work is therefore mostly definitional: ensuring framework claims at the function-canon layer don't smuggle in cross-layer claims (a claim about a particular service this Sunday is a function-canon claim; a claim about all services everywhere is a compiled-canon claim). Open: function canon drift is the framework's mechanism for explaining how compiled canon ages without explicit refactor — small drift in function canon each run accumulates into compiled-canon drift over time. Not yet operationalized.

primitives.name: Top / centre / sub canon — the three-position vertical scope axis
primitives.summary: Vertical scope dimension applying at every layer of the four-layer stack (kernel, compiled, artefact, function). Three positions, not two. SUB CANON = below the observer's wrapper — subconscious processing for human observers, aggregated outputs of lower-ring sub-observers composing the harness for any observer-class. CENTRE CANON = the observer's own — the wrapper's prism refraction of the whole, what was originally called 'global canon' in Pav's architectural sketch. The observer's rendered world. The space where the observer reads itself reading things. TOP CANON = above the observer's wrapper — the broader context the observer is embedded in but cannot fully render. Includes what higher-ring observers can see that this observer cannot, plus the substrate the higher-ring observer-class treats as kernel. Sub and top are POLAR OPPOSITES; centre canon is where the wrapper's render mediates between them (centre = sub ⋈±∓ top, in whiteboard sign-discipline). primitives.name: Three-tier epistemic framework — epistemological / ontological-candidate / speculative · canon procedure for tier-tagging claims

primitives.name: Observer-dependence of canon-stack reading

Cont 22's discipline: every framework claim about canon at any layer must name the observer-class it's read from. The framework's own definitions become observer-relative, not absolute. primitives.summary: The cont 22 canon-stack vocabulary expressed mathematically and mapped onto the framework's existing observer architecture. primitives.name: Framework outputs are verbs
primitives.summary: Meta-primitive: the construct studies, continuations, manifestos, tools, diagrams, heat maps, and timelines the framework produces are VERBS, not nouns. They are actions of the framework being itself — they are the framework doing its work — they are not artifacts that describe the framework. The distinction has operational consequences: if outputs are nouns, reading is consumption (one author, many readers); if outputs are verbs, engagement is participation (many participants each producing their own). The subject unraveler tool is the cleanest instance of this distinction made operational — the tool exists so readers can unravel their own subjects using the framework's template, producing their own construct studies. Each artifact-type is a verb-template: continuation = WRITING-A-CONTINUATION; construct study = COMPILING-A-CONSTRUCT-STUDY; diagram = DIAGRAMMING; heat map = MAPPING; timeline = LOGGING; manifesto = DECLARING. The framework's index page is the directory of available verbs. Refines cont 19's aggregation-discipline (aggregation is itself a verb at meta level; the framework is verb-shaped at meta and verb-shaped at every output level). Connects to cont 20's canon dormancy (verbs can go dormant — a construct study read once and never engaged-with-again is a verb that ran once). Surfaced cont 21 §5 from Pav's seed: 'the various formats spawning from the same framework are verbs.'
primitives.counter: Promotion requires a construct study or set of artifacts produced by someone other than Pav and Claude using the framework's templates and verb-forms; operational purchase showing verb-vs-noun distinction changes engagement in measurable ways (annotation rate via Hypothes.is, Contribute submissions); a worked example of someone running the subject unraveler to compile their own construct study and shipping it back. The most-dependent-on-external-engagement candidate of the cont-21 set. Outreach (still queued from audit v04) is the natural carrier for testing it. Open: the verbs claim may need a different evaluation criterion from procedural-connection-must-be-measurable — it's a meta-level claim about engagement-mode, not a substrate-connection claim, so the right criterion may be closer to operational-purchase / engagement-pattern (cont 21 §7 #5).

primitives.name: Agnostic pull becomes desolation
primitives.summary: Reading-grade insight (rather than a structural primitive itself): for the agnostic toward a given canon — someone who cannot or does not commit to the canon's specific protocol — the pull-engine that canon offers does not produce its intended attractor-state. It produces ABSENCE. The agnostic can describe what rapture would be, recognize it in others, study it intellectually, but cannot enter it because entering requires the protocol commitment that the agnostic stance forbids. The result is not neutrality; it is desolation. Explains why the secular-but-not-spiritual configuration in late-modern Western Europe carries a depressive load that the secular-spiritual Nordic configuration does not: the Nordic case found wake-forms (meditation, mindfulness, contemplative practice, secular ritual) that give the pull-engine an alternative substrate-resident protocol; the secular-but-not-spiritual case did not. The framework's own agnostic stance toward god is intellectual discipline (Lakatosian bracketing-the-unanswerable), not a lived stance toward meaning. Readers adopting the framework's agnostic stance need a successor protocol the framework can point to. Applied to religion essay §03 (v1.3 reading note) at cont 21 §4.
primitives.counter: Needs a measurable indicator. The claim that secular-but-not-spiritual configurations carry a depressive load above secular-spiritual configurations is testable in principle (depression-and-meaning-survey deltas between Nordic and post-Catholic secular regions, controlled for material conditions). Without the indicator, the reading is plausible-but-untested (cont 21 §7 #4). Note: this is positioned as a reading-grade insight rather than a structural primitive, so the promotion bar is somewhat different — graduating it would mean either (a) measuring the depressive-load delta empirically, or (b) folding it into a more structural primitive about pull-engine portability.

primitives.name: Canon dormancy with imparted learning on return
primitives.summary: Canon at the social-substrate ring (and at every ring above biology) does not dissolve. It either persists (load-bearing maintained), goes dormant (load-bearing migrated away but the canon preserved as procedural memory in the population's default behavior), or waits in an open action-space (dormant before successor compiled, multiple candidate carriers being scouted). Dormancy is reversible: if the squeeze that produced the canon returns — or any sufficiently similar squeeze emerges — the canon can wake. When it wakes, it does not return identical; it returns refactored, carrying whatever the dormancy period imparted as the new substrate the wake-compile runs on. Three layers of imparted learning operate during dormancy: substrate evolution (the biological/technological/infrastructural/cognitive substrate the canon originally compiled against has itself changed), successor-carrier residue (alternative carriers that absorbed pieces of the function during dormancy leave patterns the wake-form must coexist with), memory of the squeeze (the population and institution carry memory of why the canon went dormant, constraining the wake-compile). Empirical anchors independent of the trigger case: religious revival (post-Soviet Orthodox, 1979 Iran Shia), traditional craft revival (bookbinding, letterpress, sourdough, fermentation), vinyl records, bicycle infrastructure. Trigger case: the marriage construct study v1.2 refactor (artifacts/marriage_v1.html) — Pav's correction "canon doesn't dissolve it becomes dormant and can come back but never in the same way with new imparted learnings." Recursive application: the framework's own canon graph runs the primitive on itself — cont 17 pruned three primitives into dormancy using "fold not delete" language, cont 18 woke procedural canon as procedural lineage in refactored form carrying the imparted learning of cont 17's pruning round. Cont 20 names the mechanism retrospectively. Promoted to canon continuation 20 (2026-05-19).
primitives.counter: Four open edges named in cont 20 §6 and §10. (1) The framework can't yet predict ahead of time which dormant canon will wake — the cont-17 prunes included one that woke (procedural canon → lineage) and two that haven't yet, with no current mechanism to explain why. (2) Cross-ring claim is implicit (dormancy described primarily at social ring with substrate carrying dormant residue at every layer) — needs explicit treatment for whether biology-ring vestigials, cognition-ring dormant memory/skill, physics-ring patterns are the same dynamic. (3) Distinguishing dormant canon from dead canon is hard predictively; observable only retrospectively. The framework's discipline assumes dormancy as default unless the substrate the canon ran on is itself destroyed. (4) The imparted-learning mechanism (§3's three layers) is descriptive rather than predictive — cleanest follow-up is a measurable case study (vinyl-record mastering / distribution / demographic deltas between 1985 and 2024) demonstrating each of the three layers operationally. Cont 20 §10 promotion-and-self-check notes: dormancy is canon, imparted-learning-mechanism is canon-as-direction with candidate operational form pending the worked metric. Partial promotion.

primitives.name: Cross-scale mediation primitive
primitives.summary: Observers at radically different scales cannot directly render each other. Their interaction is mediated through intermediate scales. The mediation is generative — it produces new emergent structures at intermediate scales that wouldn't exist if the extremes could interact directly. Pattern recurs at cell↔ecosystem, person↔civilization, subatomic↔macroscopic, latent↔interface. The framework's substrate ladder is built on this without naming it explicitly until now.

primitives.name: 0 / not-0 as foundational distinction
primitives.summary: The first fuzzy plank that compiles into the first canon item is the binary distinction itself — Spencer-Brown's marked / unmarked, Hegel's Being / Nothing as Becoming. primitives.name: Religious / mystical canon as fidelity trade-off
primitives.summary: Religious, mystical, and fictional canon-systems are real canon — valid as canon — that optimize for compile fidelity along the meaning-up axis (synthesis, ritual, inherited symbolic memory, communal cohesion) at the cost of forward-compile along the detail-down axis (scientific decomposition, technological manifestation). Different canon-systems optimize different axes; the framework's vocabulary names the trade-off without ranking the directions. Distinct from canon-truth (different materials of canon-formation).

primitives.name: Inherited symbolic memory as compressed canon
primitives.summary: Symbol systems (myth, religion, fiction, ritual) function as long-timescale carrier-artifact substrates that preserve compiled meaning across generations using compression patterns the originating context has often forgotten. The pattern decompresses when later observers find the right key. Caterpillar-to-butterfly: the symbol carries structure across discontinuous transitions when the originating substrate can't be reached directly.

A⁺×A⁻ = dialectical tension (productive when generative, paralytic when locked). primitives.name: Phantom mass / latent gravity

primitives.name: Slice-viewer constraint
primitives.summary: The observer perceives latent space as a slice-of-a-slice-of-a-slice, holding most dimensions fixed and walking one at a time. Made explicit continuation 14 after the Functions-in-Hyperspace carrier: with three or more inputs to a function you cannot view the whole surface at once; you hold n-1 parameters constant and scan the remaining one. This is the mathematical form of the harness / wrapper / inner-sandbox limit — observers are slice-viewers in their own latent space. Time is just one of these slices (cone-profile refactor). The slice the observer happens to be on is what feels like 'now' or 'this'; the rest of the function exists but is computed only when traversed. Sharpened continuation 17: slice-viewer is the *perceptual constraint underneath planes-as-nodes* (cont 16). Hidden protocols are sequence-knowledge precisely because observers are slice-locked — they traverse the plane-node-network one node at a time rather than perceiving all nodes simultaneously. The two primitives are not redundant; slice-viewer is what makes planes-as-nodes traversal a *sequence* rather than a parallel render.
primitives.counter: The framing makes the constraint mathematically vivid; the cont-17 sharpening connects it operationally to planes-as-nodes. Promotion to canon requires a worked example where slice-viewer-aware design produces measurably different multi-agent behavior than slice-blind design.

primitives.name: Multi-architecture universal approximation
primitives.summary: MLPs, Taylor series, Fourier series — three structurally different architectures, all proven universal function approximators. Different fuzzy compile-paths, same canon target at the limit. The framework's multi-possibility deposition primitive gains its mathematical scaffold here: the existence of multiple universally-converging architectures is what justifies depositing N scout paths rather than betting on one. A corollary: 'the same function' is observer-relative — at finite parameter budgets the three architectures produce phenotypically distinguishable surfaces; only at the asymptotic limit do they become identical. So multi-path equivalence is a limit-claim, and finite-resource observers see genuine differences between paths even when targeting the same canon.
primitives.counter: Universal approximation theorems are existence results, not constructive ones; they say a function exists, not how to find it efficiently. The candidate is structurally true but operationally less informative than it first appears.

primitives.name: Generalist-over-specialist (MAMMAL vs AlphaFold)
primitives.summary: Real-time validation of emergent-garden discipline. Slow-fast pushout in action: MAMMAL has the slower-broader cone profile and wins on downstream utility.
primitives.counter: One pair of foundation models is one comparison. The framework's broader claim — generalist always beats specialist when both have adequate compute — is not yet supported by enough comparisons. Hold candidate until N grows.

primitives.name: Holographic wrapper / Bragg-membrane interface
primitives.summary: Architecture specification (not metaphor): the framework's wrapper / membrane primitive can be instantiated as a Lippmann-style Bragg-reflection layer that selectively transmits content based on the receiving observer's cone angle. Same physical-substrate carrier (a thin recorded interference layer) re-projects different content to different observer positions. Status blocked-by-engineering rather than blocked-by-thinking until that test is run.

The candidate stands or falls on whether an actual hologram-like agent-interface architecture can be built and shown to behave differently from message-passing systems. Cont-17 marks this explicitly as awaiting engineering work to test.

primitives.name: ANDI as slow-fast pushout of optimization
primitives.summary: ANDI (Adaptive Norm-Distribution Interface, Khasia 2026) is the slow-fast pushout primitive applied to gradient descent. Two parent observers: 'fully pointwise, cheap, no structure' (AdamW) and 'fully structural, expensive, full matrix awareness' (spectral methods). ANDI sits in their cone-overlap — approximating structural awareness via elementwise norm-equilibration. Matches spectral convergence at AdamW's O(N) cost on ResNet-9; outperforms both on NanoGPT; scales to 8B params via LoRA on Llama-3. Additionally: norm equilibration is the local form of viability-band maintenance — preventing any single dimension from dominating, which would push toward the freeze / explode boundary at the parameter level. The framework's criticality Γ predicts exactly this kind of operation should be discoverable by gradient-descent on optimizer design.
primitives.counter: ANDI is one optimizer; the pushout claim is structurally clean but the framework should not overload one example with too much theoretical weight. Watch for whether the next-generation optimizers also occupy similar cone-overlap positions before promoting to canon.

primitives.name: Catalyst principle

Worked examples each needed an external catalyst the framework couldn't have generated internally: the Steve Mould Lippmann video catalyzed the holographic-wrapper candidate; the Aleph/EBM Turing Post video catalyzed the A⁻-as-primary refactor; Litman & Guo's generalization-theory paper mapped onto canon at neural-network scale; Pav's correction of cont-17 pruning catalyzed procedural lineage as canon; Pav's correction of cont-18's §10 worry catalyzed the explicit aggregation-discipline framing. Operational consequence: outreach is not optional but the framework's growth fuel; sustained internal-only development predicts slower growth.
